forward_patch:
--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,25 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+depends_on:
+- 01M4X6ZBTA66TCPVYM41QR0ACD
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8680'
+title: Load the requested related boards at the same time
+---
+## What
+divergence.md §16, L5. Related boards load one at a time: the loop answers one board request at a time (S/Tool/KanbanGraph.swift:604-607). Change: load all requested related boards at the same time. This is work on the Swift package (S/ = Sources/FoundationModelsKanban/). After the KanbanHost task, this loop is in the host or in the session view. Each load goes through the one host table, so the "load once" rule stays true: two requests for the same board wait for one load.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] A call that reaches two or more related boards starts their loads at the same time.
+- [ ] Two requests for the same related board at the same time give one load.
+- [ ] The result of the call does not change.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] A test with two related boards and a slow load hook shows that the loads overlap.
+- [ ] A test that two calls that reach the same related board give one load.
+- [ ] Tests use temporary fixture folders. Never use the `.kanban/` of this repo (it is a Rust board).
+- [ ] `swift test` passes.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file
